ruleDefinitions.name: Aruba Network Service Potential DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading activity via the Aruba Networks Virtual Intranet Access "arubanetsvc.exe" process using DLL Search Order Hijacking Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\arubanetsvc\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\wtsapi32\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\msvcr100\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\msvcp100\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dbgcore\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\wininet\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\iphlpapi\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\version\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\cryptsp\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\cryptbase\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\wldp\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\profapi\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\sspicli\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\winsta\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dpapi\\\.dll$"))) AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
